purpose: held-out, exactly-matched-coverage benchmark of reproducibility-aware selective review against fixed-reference confidence baselines
preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on train partition only; no model selection, tuning, calibration on test

policies.disagreement_only: 1-(number of audit fits matching reference class)/30

selection: per test dataset-model cell and budget, select the top ceil((1-coverage)*N) review candidates using unlabeled scores; exact matched coverage across policies; deterministic SHA-256(caseID,tie_seed) to break ties; no test labels consumed in selection
inference: paired nonparametric case bootstrap with 2000 fixed-mask replicates, seed 20261104, per-cell exploratory 95-percentile intervals; no multiplicity-corrected superiority claim
primary_claim: heterogeneity and held-out score-ranking comparison; no universal superiority without external data
leakage_guards: no policy parameters fit to test labels
note: All reported results from this protocol remain independent of the prior A01 validation-selected model and A02 split-42/split-73 explorations. Dataset selection and methods were informed by A01/A02, so inference is not a preregistered discovery test.
